scope: Official Fortnite physical events relevant to France and Europe, including public operations and attendance planning

policy.official_only: Physical event existence requires Epic/Fortnite, direct organizer/venue or officially identified partner evidence. Fan meetups and unofficial viewing parties remain discovery-only and never enter the canonical ledger as confirmed.
policy.canonical_identity: physical_event_id is stable for the same logical event/run. A new city or genuinely separate activation receives a new ID. Additional sessions or zones at the same event do not create a new physical_event_id.
policy.venue_resolution: Use venue_id whenever a canonical venue exists. CITY-only records remain valid until an official venue is published. Never infer an exact building from a city announcement.
policy.access_separation: Admission/access requirements come from fortnite-physical-access-france.json and remain distinct from ticket inventory. A generic preregistration form is not attendance registration unless explicitly stated.
policy.session_model: Store public sessions separately from tournament matches. Opening hours, viewing slots, meet-and-greets, check-in windows and stand sessions can have session_id/status/access independently.
policy.zone_model: A session may target venue space_id/zone_id only if that space is officially identified. Unknown hall/stand location stays null.
policy.ticketing_bridge: Ticket availability is sourced from fortnite-ticketing-france.json. The physical-event ledger may summarize current_ticket_state but never overrides a newer ticketing entry.
policy.competitive_bridge: A LAN may link competition_id/phase_id/session_id but physical attendance and competitive scheduling stay separate. Venue opening time is never automatically match start time.
policy.calendar_projection: FEATURED for official LANs and major France/Europe activations; CALENDAR for useful viewing parties, conventions, partner activations and official stands with actionable time/location; LEDGER_ONLY for low-value or incomplete physical signals.
policy.address_and_geo: Calendar LOCATION uses the best verified venue/address. GEO only if verified. Do not fabricate map coordinates, postal address, hall or entrance.
policy.availability_guard: AVAILABLE/LOW/NEARLY/SOLD_OUT must come from the ticketing ledger at the appropriate global/session/category scope. A sold-out VIP category never makes the full event sold out.
policy.capacity_guard: Venue capacity, event quota and remaining places are never inferred from venue size or seating maps. Store only explicit exact-scope figures.
policy.onsite_guard: Age, ID, bag, re-entry, security, queue, PMR/accessibility, companion and last-entry rules must come from the access ledger/direct source and never from generic assumptions.
policy.history: Append-only for venue changes, new sessions/zones, access changes, ticketing bridge transitions, postponement/cancellation and organizer corrections.
policy.anti_noise: No write for a simple recheck, derived readiness score or refreshed timestamp without a material change.

entries.title: Reload Elite Series Championship — EWC 2026 — Paris

history.note: Generic EWC preregistration was represented as REGISTER_INTEREST and did not imply admission.
A previously followed EWC ticket page placed the championship at Boulevard City, Riyadh.
Current exact Fortnite Championship details and EWC relocation material restored Paris at CITY precision.
EWC 2026 Media Guide identifies Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, 1 Place de la Porte de Versailles, 75015 Paris, as the EWC 2026 host site. No Fortnite-specific hall/stage is asserted.

EWC official Survival Guide provides a concrete public spectator path: Fortnite watch parties across the venue require a valid Fan Fest ticket for the day. Main-stage Fortnite tickets are explicitly sold out; this does not mean the whole EWC/Fan Fest is sold out.
Added a date-range-only PUBLIC_VIEWING session for official watch parties. No exact hours, hall, entrance, capacity or Fan Fest inventory are inferred.

Fortnite Competitive confirms the first in-person Mobile Series Championship at BLAST Studios in Copenhagen on Oct 24-25, 2026. Public attendance, ticketing, exact match times, street address and onsite access rules remain UNKNOWN.
